name: Novara Property Care
description: A considered digital presence for property care across London and Essex.
intro: A calm, confident identity for a business built on attention to detail. The website brings cleaning, grounds maintenance and property care together with clear routes to each service.
focus: Help managing agents and property owners understand the offer and make an enquiry with confidence.

name: CDM Capital
description: A refined investment-sector presence, built around clarity and confidence.
intro: An editorial approach to a specialist investment-sector website. Restrained typography, considered spacing and a clear information hierarchy give a complex offering room to breathe.
focus: Make specialist information easier to explore while giving the brand a coherent, professional presence.

name: Clear Path Waste
description: A straightforward service website with a clear path from search to enquiry.
intro: A direct, practical website for rubbish removal across East London and Essex. Services, coverage and the next step are easy to find, with a visual identity that feels approachable and distinctive.
focus: Connect local service intent with useful information and a simple quote journey.

name: Knight & Day Drainage & Plumbing
description: A service-first website that makes urgent plumbing help easy to find.
intro: For a drainage and plumbing business, speed of understanding matters. The site puts emergency help, service coverage and contact options within easy reach.
focus: Give homeowners and businesses a direct route to the right service and the right conversation.

name: F7 Coaching
description: A distinctive coaching website with bookings, schedules and admin tools.
scope: Admin tools for managing the experience
intro: A digital experience for F7 Coaching that brings the football coaching offer, session information and booking journey together. The visual direction uses the brand’s energetic identity while making key actions easier to find.
focus: Give players and parents a clear route to session information and booking, supported by tools for managing the experience.
